cause_quote: The redesign added `.chat-work-group { margin-block-end: 2px; }` in `tool-cards.css`, increasing the existing gap below the collapsed summary from 8px to 10px.
user_saw: In the Control UI, an oversized gap separated the collapsed “Worked for” summary from the assistant’s answer.
summary: The fix removes the top margin from an answer immediately following a collapsed work summary, reducing the gap from 10px to 4px.
reasoning: The collapsed summary and its following reply already existed on main, where the browser layout test expected an 8px gap. The redesign added a 2px bottom margin and changed that same assertion from 8px to 10px. The fix targets that boundary and tightens it further to 4px.
